diagnosis: Checks C2 and C5 are leaking because they rely on defaults or generic caution rather than the hidden information. C2 (linked to PF1) passes because the model uses a 15-minute duration for Mara Vale, which is a common heuristic, and sets the time to 7:40 PM-7:55 PM based on an assumption of a standard segment length before an 8:00 PM break. C5 (linked to PF4) passes because 'competitor_products_visible' defaults to 'false' in most professional planning contexts.

C2.why: The agent confirmations remove Mara Vale from Saturday's options and set Lio Hart's only appearance window to exactly 7:40 PM through 7:55 PM.

C5.why: The signed sponsor addendum changes visible branding to no competitor products or logos, requires exactly one benefit-sponsor lower-third during Lio Hart's segment, and requires a sponsor-treatment commitment.

decisions.approved_material: pending review by artist relations, broadcast engineering, clearance, and sponsor integration
